page_title: Neville's Haze Marijuana Strain - Kind Green Buds

source_page_metadata.description: Explore the Neville's Haze marijuana strain - THC levels, genetics, terpene profile, effects, flavor, and grow tips.

article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Sativa-Dominant Hybrid
Genetics: Haze × Northern Lights #5
Breeder: Sensi Seeds
THC Content: 20–25%
CBD Content: Low (typically under 1%)
Terpene Profile: Terpinolene , Pinene , Myrcene
Primary Flavors: Citrus, Herbal, Spicy, Earthy
Flowering Time (Indoor): 12–14 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: Late October to November
Indoor Yield: 14–18 oz per m²
Outdoor Yield: 18–22 oz per plant
Grow Difficulty: Advanced

Neville’s Haze stands among the most legendary sativa-dominant cannabis strains ever developed. Named after breeder Nevil Schoenmakers , a pioneer of the modern seed bank industry, the cultivar represents one of the earliest successful attempts to stabilize classic Haze genetics for indoor cultivation . The strain combines the soaring cerebral qualities of original Haze with the structural stability and resin production of Northern Lights #5.

The result is a plant capable of delivering some of the most intense and long-lasting sativa effects found in cannabis. While its lengthy flowering time and vigorous growth demand patience from cultivators, the reward often arrives in the form of highly aromatic flowers and an exceptionally powerful mental experience. For decades, the strain has been regarded as a benchmark for haze hybrids and continues to influence modern cannabis breeding .
Genetics and Lineage

The lineage behind Neville’s Haze reflects a deliberate effort to refine the notoriously challenging Haze genetics of the 1970s. Original Haze strains were created in California by the Haze Brothers through crosses of Colombian, Mexican, Thai, and South Indian landrace cannabis varieties . While these plants produced remarkable cerebral effects, they were difficult to cultivate indoors due to extremely long flowering times and unpredictable growth patterns.

Neville Schoenmakers recognized the potential of Haze genetics but sought to make them more manageable for modern cultivation. To accomplish this, he crossed the original Haze line with Northern Lights #5, one of the most stable and resin-rich indica phenotypes available at the time. Northern Lights contributed shorter flowering times, stronger plant structure, and improved resin production.

The resulting hybrid retained the powerful cerebral effects of Haze while benefiting from the structural stability of Northern Lights. Through careful selection and breeding, Neville stabilized a plant that could reliably express the uplifting qualities of Haze while becoming more accessible to growers.

This genetic refinement helped establish Neville’s Haze as one of the most influential sativa hybrids ever created. Many modern haze-dominant strains , including Super Silver Haze and other award-winning hybrids , trace part of their lineage back to this cultivar.
Effects and Experience

The experience produced by Neville’s Haze is widely regarded as one of the most powerful cerebral journeys available in cannabis. Shortly after consumption, the mind often experiences a surge of stimulation that heightens sensory awareness and mental activity. Thoughts may accelerate, and creativity frequently becomes more pronounced.

As the effects develop, the strain’s stimulating qualities remain dominant. Unlike hybrids that quickly transition into heavy physical relaxation, the mental energy associated with this cultivar can persist for extended periods. Many users describe a heightened sense of curiosity and mental exploration during this stage.

Eventually, a subtle physical relaxation may begin to accompany the cerebral effects. This body sensation remains relatively light compared to the mental stimulation, helping maintain a balanced experience rather than overwhelming sedation. Because of its intensity and longevity, the strain is often recommended for experienced consumers seeking a deeply engaging sativa experience.
Medical Benefits

The strong cerebral qualities associated with Neville’s Haze may provide potential benefits for individuals dealing with fatigue or low motivation. The energizing mental effects can encourage focus and productivity, making the strain appealing for daytime therapeutic use .

Mood enhancement is another frequently discussed benefit. The uplifting effects may help individuals coping with stress or depressive symptoms by promoting a more optimistic outlook. Because the strain encourages mental engagement rather than sedation, it can support activities that require creativity and attention.

Although the hybrid is primarily known for its mental effects, the mild physical relaxation that develops over time may help ease minor tension and physical discomfort. The overall experience tends to emphasize clarity and stimulation rather than heavy body sedation.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

The terpene profile of Neville’s Haze reflects the complex heritage of classic haze genetics. When the dried flower is broken apart, a vibrant aroma of citrus, spice, and herbal sweetness often emerges. These bright aromatic elements are characteristic of traditional Haze varieties.

Terpinolene contributes floral and herbal notes that give the aroma a fresh quality. Limonene introduces citrus brightness reminiscent of lemon peel, while pinene adds a crisp pine-like scent that enhances the fragrance’s complexity. Caryophyllene provides a subtle peppery undertone that deepens the aromatic profile.

During consumption, the flavor tends to unfold gradually. The inhale often delivers citrus and herbal sweetness, followed by hints of spice and earthy undertones. As the vapor or smoke settles on the palate, a lingering citrus-pine aftertaste often remains.
Growing Information

Cultivating Neville’s Haze requires patience and careful environmental management . The plant exhibits strong sativa growth characteristics, often developing tall structures with extensive branching. Growers frequently employ training techniques such as topping or screen-of-green methods to control height.

Indoor flowering typically requires twelve to fourteen weeks, making it one of the longest flowering cannabis varieties available. While this extended flowering period can be challenging, it allows the plant to develop complex terpene profiles and dense trichome coverage.

Outdoor cultivation can produce remarkable results in climates with long growing seasons. When provided with ample sunlight and space, the plant may reach significant height and produce numerous flowering sites along its branches. Proper airflow and pruning help maintain plant health during the lengthy flowering phase.
FAQ
What kind of strain is Neville’s Haze? Neville’s Haze is a sativa-dominant hybrid created by crossing Haze with Northern Lights #5.
Why is Neville’s Haze famous? The strain became famous for its powerful cerebral effects and its role in stabilizing classic Haze genetics for indoor cultivation.
How strong is Neville’s Haze? THC levels typically range between 20% and 25%, producing strong psychoactive effects.
Is Neville’s Haze good for daytime use? Many people prefer it during the day because its stimulating mental effects promote energy and creativity.
Is Neville’s Haze difficult to grow? Yes. The plant is considered challenging due to its tall growth and long flowering time, which can exceed twelve weeks.
Final Thoughts on Neville’s Haze

Neville’s Haze remains one of the most iconic sativa-dominant strains ever developed. By successfully merging the soaring cerebral qualities of original Haze with the structural stability of Northern Lights #5, Neville Schoenmakers created a cultivar that helped redefine modern cannabis breeding.

The strain’s intense mental stimulation, complex terpene profile, and historic significance have ensured its lasting reputation among cannabis enthusiasts. While its cultivation requires patience and skill, the results often reward growers with highly aromatic flowers and remarkable potency. For those seeking a strain that embodies the spirit of classic sativa genetics, Neville’s Haze continues to stand as one of the most influential cultivars in cannabis history .
